faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MNNIT Allahabad JRA recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) position at MNNIT Allahabad is 22nd September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRA post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE/B.Tech/M.Sc./M.Tech. in Biotechnology/Lifesciences/Bioinformatics, M. Pharm./ M.V.Sc. or equivalent with First Division to be eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) post is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRA role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a stipend of Rs. 25,000 per month for the first two years and Rs. 28,000 per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the email is sent before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for MNNIT Allahabad JRA recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC/SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the JRA post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) position at MNNIT Allahabad.

faq.question: Q9. Does MNNIT Allahabad offer age relaxation for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, the upper age limit is relaxed by up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/PH and women candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
